arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK036. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. One diving shark, HEAD ALREADY SUBMERGED at lower LEFT, rounded gray back arches upward and over toward RIGHT, body narrowing into tail to right above/among the splash. Draw only source-visible anatomy, no eye or visible head invented. White/pale-blue attached splash surrounds the left impact and runs in low droplets toward right. Preserve the large transparent space under the arch. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
